description: Cell-surface and HLA-presented protein targets with an associated therapeutic binder program, screened against a Libby case by the preclinical_biomarker_surveyor agent. Machine-generated from the upstream cell_protein_target_paint workbook; do not hand-edit.

targets.localization_notes: GPI-anchored ectoenzyme on the cell surface (UniProt P10696); shed into exosomes.
targets.cancer_relevance: Onco-testicular antigen re-expressed in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, mesothelioma, ovarian cancer, and germ-cell tumors. Bispecific ALPPL2 x CD89 reprograms macrophages preclinically; ALPPL2 also a biomarker target.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: ALPPL2 expression in PDAC vs minimal normal-tissue baseline (PMID 40897818); restricted normal expression to placenta and germ cells (referenced in PMID 40209501).
targets.liabilities: Germ-cell/testicular expression; Shed antigen via GPI cleavage; Limited clinical program currently
targets.notes: Onco-testicular surface target with macrophage-reprogramming bispecific concept.

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane receptor (UniProt Q9H6X2); on tumor endothelium and tumor-cell surface.
targets.cancer_relevance: Surface receptor up-regulated on tumor vasculature and on triple-negative breast, neuroendocrine, and small-cell lung carcinoma cells. Anti-TEM8 mAbs and CAR-T explored preclinically.
targets.liabilities: Tumor-endothelial component creates vascular leak risk; Functional link to anthrax-toxin biology must be controlled; Limited clinical program currently
targets.notes: Tumor-vascular + tumor-cell preclinical target.

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane TAM-family RTK (UniProt P30530).
targets.cancer_relevance: Up-regulated in EMT / drug-resistance phenotypes across NSCLC, TNBC, AML, melanoma, and pancreatic cancer. Enapotamab vedotin (HuMax-AXL-ADC) and mecbotamab vedotin ADCs in trials; small-molecule bemcentinib also in development.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: AXL expression on TKI-resistant NSCLC and TNBC cell lines and patient samples documented in clinical and translational literature (cached AXL_solid_rel summaries).
targets.liabilities: Normal myeloid/endothelial AXL expression; Plasticity of AXL+ EMT subpopulations; Soluble shed AXL sink
targets.notes: Reintroduced from the prior run -- mixed evidence (clinical-stage ADCs, broad preclinical EMT/resistance signal).

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane enzyme induced by HIF; surface-accessible on clear-cell RCC (UniProt Q16790; PMID 32998233).
targets.cancer_relevance: Highly induced by VHL loss in ~95% of clear-cell renal cell carcinomas and broadly across hypoxic regions of multiple solid tumors; near-absent in normal kidney parenchyma. Validated PET imaging target (89Zr-girentuximab) and ongoing CAR-T / ADC programs.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: Reviews PMIDs 32998233, 20359812, and 20709527 establish CAIX as a clear-cell RCC marker with strong tumor-vs-normal contrast; meta-analysis PMID 31901907 reports prognostic value of CAIX IHC.
targets.liabilities: GI expression (stomach, biliary tree) is a normal-tissue baseline; Hypoxic induction means CAIX can appear off-target in inflamed tissues; Heterogeneity within ccRCC tumors

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane Ig-superfamily co-receptor on B cells (UniProt P15391).
targets.cancer_relevance: Pan-B-cell surface marker on essentially all B-ALL, most B-cell lymphomas, and CLL. Foundational target for CAR-T (tisagenlecleucel, axicabtagene, brexucabtagene, lisocabtagene), bispecifics (blinatumomab CD19xCD3), and a CD19 ADC (loncastuximab tesirine).
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: Reviews PMIDs 30680780 and 35012754 detail CD19 expression on malignant and normal B cells; landmark trials PMIDs 29226797 (axicabtagene NEJM ZUMA-1) and 30501490 (tisagenlecleucel NEJM JULIET) confirm clinical actionability of B-cell-restricted expression.
targets.liabilities: B-cell aplasia and hypogammaglobulinemia; CRS / ICANS; Antigen loss with isoform-skipping mutations
targets.notes: Hematologic exemplar; included for binder-design context, not as a solid-tumor target.

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane Ig-superfamily immune-checkpoint ligand (UniProt P41217).
targets.cancer_relevance: Up-regulated on chronic lymphocytic leukemia, multiple myeloma, AML, and solid tumors (melanoma, ovarian); samalizumab (anti-CD200) was a clinical-stage program; preclinical CD200 CAR-T and bispecifics.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: CD200 over-expression in CLL and AML vs normal lymphocytes (referenced in PMID 42092725); CD200 in melanoma TME (PMID 41873856).
targets.liabilities: Broad normal-tissue expression (neurons, endothelium); Immune-checkpoint axis -- need to assess effect on healthy immunity; Limited current clinical program
targets.notes: Immune-checkpoint surface ligand with hematologic + solid-tumor preclinical signal.

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane Ig-superfamily protein (UniProt Q5ZPR3); broad tumor-cell surface staining and tumor-vascular expression.
targets.cancer_relevance: Pan-cancer over-expression (NSCLC, prostate, breast, ovarian, pancreatic, melanoma, osteosarcoma, neuroblastoma, glioma) with relatively low normal-tissue surface expression. Multiple ADCs (ifinatamab deruxtecan, MGC018), CAR-T (especially pediatric solid tumors), and bispecifics in trials.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: Reviews PMIDs 34349762 and 33051306 collate IHC expression across pan-cancer cohorts and contrast with restricted normal tissue baselines; PMIDs 38327753 and 40946079 review clinical-stage agents and their target dependence; PMID 36284349 covers immunology and clinical immunotherapy.
targets.liabilities: Some normal expression on activated lymphocytes / vascular endothelium; Imperfect IHC standardization between sponsors; Heterogeneous spatial expression

targets.localization_notes: Four-transmembrane tetraspanin on mature B cells and a subset of T cells (UniProt P11049).
targets.cancer_relevance: B-cell-lineage surface antigen on B-NHL (DLBCL, FL, MCL) and AML; naratuximab emtansine, 177Lu-lilotomab satetraxetan, BI 836826 antibody, and CD37-CAR-T are in trials.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: CD37 on mature B cells and B-NHL vs absent on early progenitors; recent phase-2 177Lu-lilotomab (PMID 41754790).
targets.liabilities: Normal B-cell depletion / hypogammaglobulinemia; Antigen loss; Tetraspanin epitope-choice constraints
targets.notes: Hematologic exemplar; informs solid-tumor tetraspanin binder design.

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane complement-regulatory protein (UniProt P15529).
targets.cancer_relevance: Over-expressed on multiple myeloma plasma cells and on prostate and other solid tumors; FOR46 / MeM-102 ADC and CD46-targeting CAR-T in preclinical / early-clinical development.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: CD46 surface up-regulation in prostate cancer vs normal documented in clinical-translational studies (referenced in PMID 41819546).
targets.liabilities: Ubiquitous low-level normal expression as complement regulator; Antigen sink potential; Hemolytic risk if complement regulation perturbed
targets.notes: Pan-tissue complement regulator -- selectivity is the main design constraint.

targets.localization_notes: Type II transmembrane TNF-family ligand (UniProt P32970); aberrantly expressed on tumor-cell surface in ccRCC and several lymphoid malignancies.
targets.cancer_relevance: Constitutively expressed on the surface of clear-cell RCC (>80% of cases), and on several B-cell and T-cell lymphomas, with tightly restricted normal expression (transiently activated lymphocytes and some dendritic cells). Multiple CAR-T and ADC programs (CTX-130, allogeneic; ARGX-110/cusatuzumab).
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: Reviews PMIDs 40388162, 39570653, 40250430, and 40973554 describe CD70 expression across RCC, lymphoma, and other tumors with the restricted normal-tissue baseline; PMID 40803958 reports the allogeneic CAR-T program leveraging this differential.
targets.liabilities: On-target effects on activated immune cells (CD27+); Antigen down-regulation under CAR-T pressure; Heterogeneous expression in RCC

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane glycoprotein (UniProt Q9H5V8); proteolytically cleaved on tumor cells.
targets.cancer_relevance: Up-regulated in breast, ovarian, oral squamous, pancreatic, and lung carcinomas with roles in EMT, anoikis resistance, and metastasis. Indocyanine-green dual antibody co-targeting CDCP1 and mesothelin used for fluorescence-guided surgery in PDAC preclinical models.
targets.liabilities: Proteolytic processing complicates epitope choice; Heterogeneous expression; Limited normal-tissue toxicity profile defined
targets.notes: Robust preclinical surface target with imaging and therapeutic concepts.

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane cadherin (UniProt Q12864); apical-basolateral on intestinal/stomach epithelium and tumor-cell surface in GI carcinomas (PMID 38452580).
targets.cancer_relevance: Highly and lineage-restricted expression in colorectal (~95%), gastric, and pancreatic adenocarcinomas, as well as neuroendocrine tumors of GI origin, with normal expression confined to GI tract. Active CAR-T programs (PMIDs 35314826, 40435215) and ADC programs.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: Tissue-microarray study PMID 38452580 (Marx 2024) profiles CDH17 across 18,131 tumors and normal tissues; CAR-T PMIDs 35314826 and 40435215 demonstrate tumor-specific killing of GI tumors while sparing normal organs preclinically; PMID 40602407 describes a CDH17 ADC overcoming GI multidrug resistance.
targets.liabilities: On-target normal intestinal expression (lateral membrane); requires liver-sparing or membrane-orientation-selective binders; Antigen heterogeneity in metastases; GI toxicity risk

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane classical cadherin (UniProt P22223).
targets.cancer_relevance: Up-regulated in basal-like breast cancer, pancreatic, gastric, ovarian, and endometrial cancers. PF-06671008 P-cadherin x CD3 bispecific and CDH3-targeting CAR-T explored.
targets.liabilities: Normal skin / mammary basal expression; Bidirectional adhesion biology; Limited current clinical program
targets.notes: Classical surface cadherin with bispecific potential.

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane classical cadherin (UniProt P55285).
targets.cancer_relevance: Over-expressed in renal cell carcinoma (papillary subtype), ovarian cancer, cholangiocarcinoma, and thyroid. Raludotatug deruxtecan (R-DXd, anti-CDH6 ADC) under active investigation in ovarian and RCC.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: CDH6 IHC in renal and ovarian tumors vs minimal adult-tissue expression (raludotatug-DXd R-DXd development; PMID 42036170).
targets.liabilities: Some renal tubule and developmental expression; Deruxtecan-class ILD risk; Need for IHC patient enrichment
targets.notes: R-DXd advancing in ovarian / RCC -- bridges preclinical and early clinical.

targets.localization_notes: GPI-anchored surface glycoprotein; also shed into plasma (long-standing serum CEA marker) (UniProt P06731).
targets.cancer_relevance: Highly expressed in colorectal (>90%), gastric, pancreatic, and a substantial fraction of NSCLC adenocarcinomas vs. restricted apical-only expression in normal colon. Active binder modalities: tusamitamab ravtansine ADC (NSCLC), CEA-TCB bispecific (cibisatamab), CAR-T.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: Review PMID 23903773 (Beauchemin 2013) covers CEACAM family expression and tumor progression; PMID 10202129 details the foundational tumor-vs-normal expression pattern; ADC-focused review PMID 39796075 frames CEACAM5 as a contemporary NSCLC target.
targets.liabilities: Soluble serum CEA acts as a sink; Cross-reactivity with CEACAM family on granulocytes / colon epithelium (engineered antibodies must discriminate); Heterogeneous staining intensity
targets.default_assay: Tumor-cell protein expression by IHC; serum/plasma assay where a validated one exists

targets.localization_notes: Tight-junction four-pass transmembrane protein; tumor-cell loss of polarity exposes the normally junction-buried epitope (UniProt P56856; reviewed in PMID 38503878).
targets.cancer_relevance: CLDN18.2 (the gastric-isoform splice variant of CLDN18) is expressed in ~40-80% of gastric/GEJ adenocarcinomas and ~50-70% of pancreatic adenocarcinomas, with isoform expression restricted to normal gastric mucosa in adults. First-in-class mAb zolbetuximab approved (SPOTLIGHT/GLOW); ADC and CAR-T programs progressing.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: Reviews PMIDs 38503878, 39637967, and 38339430 detail IHC scoring and prevalence in gastric and pancreatic cancer vs. restricted normal gastric epithelium; CAP/IASLC-style guideline PMID 39098518 standardizes the assay used to enrich for CLDN18.2-high tumors.
targets.liabilities: Nausea/vomiting from on-target gastric mucosa engagement; Loss of epitope availability if tight junctions re-form; Heterogeneous expression within and between tumor regions

indications: CLDN18.2+ HER2- gastric/GEJ adenocarcinoma (1L combo chemo)

targets.protein_name: C-type lectin domain family 12 member A (CLL-1)
targets.localization_notes: Type II transmembrane C-type lectin on myeloid cells (UniProt Q5QGZ9).
targets.cancer_relevance: Surface antigen on acute myeloid leukemia blasts and leukemic stem cells (LSCs) with sparing of normal HSCs; tepoditamab (CLEC12A x CD3), CLL-1 CAR-T (KITE-222), and CLL-1 / CD33 dual CAR-T in trials.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: CLEC12A expression on AML blasts and LSCs vs normal HSCs documented in immunotherapeutic atlas (PMID 41959675).
targets.liabilities: Normal granulocyte / monocyte expression -> myelosuppression; CRS with bispecifics; Antigen loss reported in CAR-T resistance
targets.notes: Active AML clinical and preclinical -- hematologic exemplar for binder design.

targets.localization_notes: Intracellular cancer/testis antigen presented on HLA class I (UniProt Q5H943).
targets.cancer_relevance: Cancer/testis antigen highly expressed in triple-negative breast cancer, gastric cancer, non-small-cell lung cancer, and cervical cancer. HLA-A*01:01-restricted TCR (Doran 2019) and follow-on NK/T-cell engagers in development.
targets.liabilities: HLA restriction (predominantly HLA-A*01:01); Heterogeneous expression; TCR-T cytokine-release risk
targets.default_assay: Antigen expression by IHC or RT-PCR, plus HLA class I genotyping
targets.notes: Cancer/testis antigen with strong TNBC/gastric/cervical preclinical-translational signal.

targets.localization_notes: Intracellular antigen accessible only via HLA class I presentation (CTAG1B/P78358; reviewed in PMID 39275923).
targets.cancer_relevance: Cancer/testis antigen expressed in 70-80% of synovial sarcoma, ~30% of myxoid liposarcoma, ~25-35% of melanoma, and subsets of NSCLC, ovarian, and esophageal cancer; expression in adult tissues restricted to germline. HLA-A*02:01-restricted peptides validated as TCR-T target (letetresgene autoleucel; precursor adoptive-T trials).
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: Reviews PMIDs 39275923, 30173534, 29770138, and 34083416 collate NY-ESO-1 expression in tumors vs. testis-restricted normal expression and detail TCR-T programs that exploit this differential.
targets.liabilities: Requires HLA-A*02:01 (or other defined HLA) restriction -- limits eligible patients; Antigen heterogeneity within tumors; Risk of HLA loss as escape mechanism
targets.default_assay: Antigen expression by IHC or RT-PCR, plus HLA class I genotyping

indications: NY-ESO-1+ synovial sarcoma, myxoid liposarcoma, NSCLC, multiple myeloma

targets.notes: Intracellular HLA-presented target -- binder modalities are TCR-T and TCR-mimic antibodies.

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane EGF-like protein with a soluble cleaved form (UniProt P80370).
targets.cancer_relevance: Oncofetal surface antigen re-expressed in neuroblastoma, hepatoblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma, small-cell lung cancer, ovarian, and adrenal cortical carcinoma. Targeted by ADCT-701 ADC in trials.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: DLK1 IHC documented in pediatric solid tumors and ovarian cancer vs adult-restricted normal pattern (review PMID 42023826).
targets.liabilities: Some adult adrenal and placental expression; Cleaved soluble form may act as sink; Pediatric exposure considerations
targets.notes: Oncofetal antigen with growing ADC interest.

targets.localization_notes: Inhibitory Notch ligand normally Golgi-restricted; aberrantly trafficked to the cell surface in neuroendocrine tumors (PMID 31215500).
targets.cancer_relevance: Expressed on the surface of >85% small cell lung cancers and high-grade neuroendocrine carcinomas, with negligible normal-tissue surface expression. Tarlatamab (DLL3 x CD3 BiTE) is FDA-approved; ADCs and CAR-T are advancing.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: Reviews PMIDs 31215500, 38730427, and 35983951 describe surface DLL3 enrichment in SCLC and neuroendocrine neoplasms vs absent normal-tissue surface expression; PMID 39023700 covers tarlatamab approval; PMID 39876075 details adverse-event management consistent with neuroendocrine restriction.
targets.liabilities: CRS and ICANS with T-cell engagers; Lineage plasticity (NEUROD1/POU2F3 subtypes) drives DLL3 loss; Variable surface vs. intracellular pool

indications: Extensive-stage small cell lung cancer (after platinum)

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane RTK; basolateral on epithelia (UniProt P00533).
targets.cancer_relevance: Driver oncogene in EGFR-mutant NSCLC and over-expressed in colorectal, head-and-neck squamous, and squamous lung. Multiple binder modalities clinically validated (cetuximab, panitumumab, amivantamab EGFR/MET bispecific, antibody-drug conjugates).
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: Review PMID 39614090 covers the changing treatment landscape of EGFR-mutant NSCLC vs normal lung; PMID 36481319 describes the amivantamab bispecific that exploits tumor-enriched EGFR+MET co-expression; PMID 38892105 reviews EGFR exon 20 insertions as a tumor-only target.
targets.liabilities: Acneiform skin rash and diarrhea from on-target normal epithelial EGFR engagement; Hypomagnesemia; Acquired secondary mutations (C797S) under TKI pressure
targets.notes: EGFRvIII (extracellular deletion variant) is captured below as a separate, glioblastoma-restricted entry.

targets.protein_name: Epidermal growth factor receptor variant III (EGFRvIII)
targets.localization_notes: Constitutively active deletion variant (exons 2-7) generating a novel extracellular junction epitope absent from wild-type EGFR (UniProt P00533; PMID 23777544).
targets.cancer_relevance: Tumor-specific extracellular neoepitope in ~25-30% of EGFR-amplified glioblastomas, with no wild-type tissue expression. Validated as a CAR-T and bispecific target; rindopepimut peptide vaccine probed the same junction.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: Reviews PMIDs 29321659 and 23777544 describe EGFRvIII as a tumor-specific neoepitope absent from normal tissues; PMID 39000281 systematically reviews CAR-T targeting in glioblastoma built on this tumor specificity.
targets.liabilities: Heterogeneous and unstable expression (~25-50% of EGFRvIII+ tumors lose the variant on recurrence); BBB penetration constraints for CNS delivery; Immune-cold tumor microenvironment of glioblastoma
targets.notes: Tumor-specific neoepitope on the same UniProt accession as wild-type EGFR (P00533); stage 2 should treat the variant epitope, not pan-EGFR, as the target.

targets.localization_notes: Type II transmembrane ectoenzyme (UniProt O14638).
targets.cancer_relevance: Up-regulated on the surface of clear-cell renal cell carcinoma, basophils/mast cells (CD203c marker), and a subset of papillary RCC. AGS-16C3F ADC was a clinical-stage RCC program.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: ENPP3 IHC over-expression in ccRCC vs minimal normal kidney expression (cached ENPP3_rcc_rel summaries).
targets.liabilities: Normal basophil / mast-cell expression; Soluble released ectoenzyme; Modest dynamic range in ccRCC
targets.notes: ccRCC mixed-evidence ADC target.

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane homophilic adhesion glycoprotein on most carcinomas (UniProt P16422).
targets.cancer_relevance: Highly expressed on essentially all epithelial carcinomas (CRC, gastric, prostate, breast, NSCLC) and on circulating tumor cells, with apical-only expression in most normal epithelia. Multiple bispecifics (catumaxomab, solitomab BiTE) and ADC programs.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: Review PMID 32507912 (Schnell 2020) summarizes 40 years of EpCAM biology and tumor-vs-normal expression patterns; PMID 34803167 reviews EpCAM-based CTC enrichment as direct evidence of tumor-cell surface accessibility.
targets.liabilities: Basolateral expression on normal epithelium drives GI AEs; Antigen abundance leads to first-dose CRS for T-cell engagers; Imperfect tumor-vs-normal selectivity

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane RTK (UniProt P29317).
targets.cancer_relevance: Over-expressed across many epithelial cancers (esophageal, gastric, lung, breast, ovarian, glioma) and drives migration / invasion. EPHA2-targeted CAR-T and bispecifics in preclinical and early-clinical development; MEDI-547 ADC historical.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: EPHA2 IHC has been reported in esophageal and lung tumors vs normal epithelium across multiple cohorts (referenced in PMID 41977404).
targets.liabilities: Some normal epithelial expression and homeostatic role in tissue boundaries; Bidirectional Eph/ephrin signalling complicates binder design
targets.notes: Long-studied surface target with renewed CAR-T interest.

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane RTK (UniProt P54760); on tumor cells and tumor vasculature.
targets.cancer_relevance: Over-expressed on Kaposi sarcoma, mesothelioma, head-and-neck, bladder, and prostate cancers; tumor-vascular component motivates anti-angiogenic / tumor-vasculature targeting.
targets.liabilities: Endothelial / vascular expression; Forward-vs-reverse signalling complexity; Limited validated clinical binder
targets.notes: Combined tumor-cell + tumor-vasculature target.

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane RTK on epithelial cells (UniProt P04626; HPA membrane localization).
targets.cancer_relevance: Driver oncogene amplified/overexpressed in ~15-20% of breast cancers and ~10-20% of gastric/GEJ adenocarcinomas, with additional 'HER2-low' populations now therapeutically relevant; also expressed in subsets of NSCLC, biliary tract, colorectal, urothelial, and salivary cancers. Foundational antigen for binder modalities (trastuzumab, T-DM1, T-DXd, bispecifics, CAR-T).
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: Slamon (2001 NEJM, PMID 11248153) established HER2 overexpression in breast cancer and response to trastuzumab; ASCO/CAP guideline (PMID 37284804) defines IHC/ISH criteria distinguishing HER2-amplified tumor cells from low-expressing normal epithelium; T-DM1 EMILIA trial (PMID 23020162) confirmed clinical actionability of differential tumor expression.
targets.liabilities: Cardiotoxicity from on-target cardiomyocyte HER2 inhibition; Intratumoral and HER2-low heterogeneity; Pneumonitis with deruxtecan payloads; Acquired loss / down-regulation under ADC pressure
targets.notes: Canonical pan-cancer surface target; included as a benchmark for stage 2's binder lookup.

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane pseudokinase RTK (UniProt P21860); broadly surface-expressed on epithelial cancers.
targets.cancer_relevance: Over-expressed and a mediator of EGFR/HER2-TKI resistance in NSCLC, breast, head-and-neck, gastric, and CRC. Patritumab deruxtecan (HER3-DXd) is in pivotal development in EGFR-mutant NSCLC and HR+ breast cancer.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: Reviews PMIDs 38239350 and 40087402 describe HER3 over-expression in tumor vs. normal tissues and its role in TKI resistance; PMID 24269963 covers the foundational ErbB family biology.
targets.liabilities: Interstitial lung disease with deruxtecan payload; Some expression on normal epithelia (skin, GI); Moderate dynamic range vs normal tissue

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane glycoprotein (UniProt P13726); aberrantly expressed on the surface of multiple carcinomas.
targets.cancer_relevance: Aberrantly expressed in cervical, ovarian, esophageal, pancreatic, NSCLC, and head-and-neck cancers, with limited expression on normal epithelial surface. Tisotumab vedotin (TF-targeted MMAE ADC) is approved for previously treated recurrent/metastatic cervical cancer; further indications under study.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: Reviews PMIDs 34748188, 36415085, 35535813, and 35962528 collate tissue-factor expression across cervical and other carcinomas vs. limited normal-tissue baseline; PMID 36842202 describes the registrational TV trial.
targets.liabilities: Risk of bleeding via TF-FVIIa pathway perturbation; Ocular AEs with MMAE payload; Some expression on activated endothelium and monocytes

targets.localization_notes: Type II transmembrane serine protease on activated cancer-associated fibroblasts and a subset of tumor cells (UniProt Q12884; PMIDs 32601975, 24470260).
targets.cancer_relevance: Highly expressed on the surface of activated cancer-associated fibroblasts in essentially all epithelial solid tumors (CRC, pancreatic, breast, NSCLC, gastric), with minimal expression in healthy adult tissues. Validated PET imaging target (FAPI tracers) and active CAR-T / bispecific / RPT programs.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: Reviews PMIDs 32601975, 24470260, 35198057, and 36594838 describe FAP expression on tumor-associated stroma vs near-absent expression in healthy adult tissues.
targets.liabilities: Expression on wound-healing and fibrotic-tissue fibroblasts; Soluble FAP in plasma may act as a sink; Stromal target, so depth of penetration matters
targets.notes: Tumor-stroma rather than tumor-cell target; valuable for theranostic and combo modalities.

targets.protein_name: Glutamate carboxypeptidase II / Prostate-specific membrane antigen
targets.localization_notes: Type II transmembrane glycoprotein on prostate epithelial cells and tumor neovasculature of many solid tumors (UniProt Q04609; PMID 38977769).
targets.cancer_relevance: Highly expressed in ~95% of prostate cancers, including castration-resistant disease, and on neovasculature of multiple solid tumors. Validated for radioligand therapy (177Lu-PSMA-617, VISION), PET imaging (68Ga-PSMA-11, 18F-DCFPyL), and emerging bispecific T-cell engagers.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: Review PMID 38977769 details PSMA expression biology and heterogeneity vs. prostate baseline; PMID 34161051 (VISION NEJM 2021) demonstrates clinical benefit of 177Lu-PSMA-617 contingent on PSMA-PET positivity; PMIDs 29320333 and 33712536 review PSMA-PET imaging selectivity for prostate tumor vs. normal patterns.
targets.liabilities: Salivary, lacrimal, kidney, and small-bowel expression drives xerostomia and renal sink; Loss of PSMA in dedifferentiated neuroendocrine prostate cancer; Heterogeneity within metastatic lesions

targets.localization_notes: GPI-anchored cell-surface receptor (UniProt P15328); apical in normal epithelia, broadly accessible on tumor surface.
targets.cancer_relevance: Highly expressed in high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma (>35% of patients with high FRalpha), with significant expression in endometrial, NSCLC adenocarcinoma, and TNBC. Mirvetuximab soravtansine (ADC) is approved in FRalpha-high platinum-resistant ovarian cancer; multiple new FRalpha ADCs in trials.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: Review PMID 32152484 (Cheung 2020) compiles FRalpha tumor-vs-normal IHC data; PMID 40508029 reports the clinically validated diagnostic biomarker thresholds in advanced ovarian cancer; meta-analysis PMID 39526448 quantifies ADC efficacy as a function of FRalpha expression.
targets.liabilities: Renal/proximal-tubule FRalpha drives off-tumor uptake of folate-conjugates; Ocular AEs (keratopathy) with mirvetuximab; Expression heterogeneity demands diagnostic IHC

indications: FRalpha-high platinum-resistant epithelial ovarian/fallopian tube/primary peritoneal cancer

targets.localization_notes: Seven-transmembrane Wnt-pathway receptor on the cell surface (UniProt O75084).
targets.cancer_relevance: Marks mammary tumor-initiating cells and is required for Wnt-driven proliferation in TNBC, gastric, and Wilms tumor models. Antibody disruption of Wnt signalling demonstrated in vivo preclinically.
targets.liabilities: Wnt-pathway essentiality in intestinal stem cells creates on-target GI risk; Multiple Frizzled paralogs complicate selectivity; Mostly preclinical -- no clinical Frizzled-7 binder approved
targets.notes: Strong preclinical Wnt-driver target; cell-of-origin marker for TNBC stem-like populations.

targets.localization_notes: GPI-anchored heparan sulfate proteoglycan with a cleaved soluble form in serum (UniProt P51654).
targets.cancer_relevance: Onco-fetal antigen re-expressed in ~70-80% of hepatocellular carcinomas, with additional expression in subsets of squamous lung, Wilms tumor, and yolk-sac tumors. Adult normal liver does not express GPC3, giving a strong tumor-vs-normal contrast. Active CAR-T, bispecific, and ADC programs.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: Reviews PMIDs 39428649, 28621802, 35251989, and 39369212 catalog GPC3 expression in HCC vs. adult liver and detail diagnostic and therapeutic implications; PMID 39569202 covers CAR-T strategies built on this contrast.
targets.liabilities: Cleaved soluble GPC3 sink; CAR-T cytokine release and on-target hepatic AEs in regenerating liver; Heterogeneity within HCC nodules
targets.default_assay: Tumor-cell protein expression by IHC; serum/plasma assay where a validated one exists
targets.notes: Oncofetal class -- highlight tag for downstream binders that exploit oncofetal expression.

targets.protein_name: G-protein coupled receptor family C group 5 member D
targets.localization_notes: Seven-transmembrane orphan GPCR with cell-surface expression on plasma cells (UniProt Q9NZD1).
targets.cancer_relevance: Lineage-restricted surface receptor on malignant plasma cells in multiple myeloma; talquetamab (GPRC5DxCD3) is FDA-approved and used as a non-overlapping target to BCMA. Included as hematologic exemplar.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: Reviews PMID 42098480 and 42066212 collate GPRC5D expression on myeloma plasma cells vs hard keratinized tissues; talquetamab phase-2 results referenced therein.
targets.liabilities: On-target oral / dermal / nail toxicities from hard-keratinized-tissue expression; Antigen loss on retreatment (PMID 42108083); CRS / ICANS
targets.notes: Hematologic exemplar; solid-tumor evidence remains thin -- treat as MM-restricted.

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane receptor-cyclase (UniProt P25092); strictly apical on normal intestinal epithelium (sequestered from systemic circulation) and broadly accessible on tumor cells with loss of polarity.
targets.cancer_relevance: Expressed in >95% of colorectal adenocarcinomas and in metastases (which lack the apical-sequestration of normal gut), with subsets in gastric, esophageal, and pancreatic. Bispecific T-cell engagers (e.g., PF-07062119) and CAR-T (PMID 39298141) are in clinical trials.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: Reviews PMIDs 34056991, 35920071, 32945718, and 27688649 describe GUCY2C tumor-vs-apical-normal expression patterns; PMID 31996389 details the GUCY2C-CD3 bispecific exploiting this access asymmetry.
targets.liabilities: GI toxicity if normal apical GUCY2C becomes accessible (e.g., mucosal damage); Antigen heterogeneity in metastasis; Bispecific CRS

targets.protein_name: Hepatitis A virus cellular receptor 1 (KIM-1 / TIM-1)
targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane Ig-mucin protein (UniProt Q96D42); shed ectodomain detectable in urine.
targets.cancer_relevance: Highly expressed on the surface of clear-cell renal cell carcinoma and a subset of ovarian clear-cell tumors with shed-ectodomain biomarker utility (urine KIM-1).
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: Urine and serum KIM-1 elevated in ccRCC; review of prognostic biomarkers (PMID 42122167); KIM-1 in chronic kidney injury contexts (PMID 42120702).
targets.liabilities: Inducible expression in acute kidney injury -> off-target binding risk; Shed soluble KIM-1 sink; Limited normal expression tightly correlated with proximal-tubule damage
targets.notes: RCC-restricted preclinical surface target; biomarker and therapy concept.

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane decoy receptor (UniProt Q14627); high surface expression on glioblastoma cells.
targets.cancer_relevance: Strongly over-expressed in ~75% of glioblastomas (highest among adult CNS tumors), with limited normal CNS expression. Active CAR-T programs (e.g., City of Hope locoregional CAR-T) and IL-13 cytokine toxin (cintredekin besudotox historically).
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: Reviews PMIDs 25247196, 36152905, 35464460, and 24723564 collate IL13RA2 IHC/RNA expression in glioblastoma vs. normal CNS; PMID 35612318 describes nanocarrier targeting consistent with the tumor-skewed expression.
targets.liabilities: Some macrophage/microglia expression in CNS tumor microenvironment; Antigen escape after CAR-T; CNS delivery constraints
targets.notes: Glioblastoma-restricted; companion target to EGFRvIII for multi-antigen CAR designs.

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane cytokine receptor alpha subunit (UniProt P26951).
targets.cancer_relevance: Highly expressed on blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm (BPDCN), AML LSCs, and a subset of ALL. Tagraxofusp (IL3-DT) is FDA-approved for BPDCN; multiple bispecifics (flotetuzumab, vibecotamab) and CAR-T (UCART123) in trials.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: CD123 high on AML/BPDCN blasts vs low on normal HSCs (review PMID 41933267).
targets.liabilities: Capillary-leak with tagraxofusp; Some normal HSC/basophil/endothelial expression; CRS with bispecifics
targets.notes: Hematologic exemplar -- clinically validated target with multiple modalities.

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane integrin alpha subunit pairing with beta1 (UniProt P26006).
targets.cancer_relevance: Up-regulated on lung adenocarcinoma, gastric, pancreatic, and bladder carcinomas; functional driver of invasion. Preclinical antibody and CAR concepts explored.
targets.liabilities: Broad normal epithelial expression; Complex multi-subunit integrin biology; No clinical-stage anti-ITGA3 binder
targets.notes: Early preclinical target -- only fresh 2025/26 surfaceome literature.

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane integrin subunit pairing with alphaV (UniProt P18564).
targets.cancer_relevance: Alphavbeta6 is induced de novo on the surface of pancreatic, head-and-neck, lung, oral, cervical, and colorectal carcinomas (largely absent on normal adult epithelium). Active ADC and imaging programs; preclinical-stage CAR-T.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: Avb6 IHC and PET imaging (68Ga-Trivehexin) demonstrate tumor-restricted expression in PDAC and HNSCC vs limited normal epithelium (review referenced in PMID 41614173).
targets.liabilities: Wound-healing avb6 induction may produce off-tumor binding in inflamed tissues; Complex multi-subunit integrin biology; No approved binder yet
targets.notes: Strong tumor-vs-normal contrast for an integrin target.

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane Ig-superfamily cell-adhesion molecule (UniProt P32004).
targets.cancer_relevance: Re-expressed on the surface of neuroblastoma, glioma, ovarian, endometrial, and a subset of GI carcinomas; City of Hope L1CAM CAR-T (developed for neuroblastoma) and antibody-drug conjugates in clinical-stage exploration.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: L1CAM IHC over-expression in ovarian and endometrial cancers vs normal endometrium documented in clinical-translational series (review referenced in PMID 41994380).
targets.liabilities: CNS / peripheral nerve expression in adults; Cleaved soluble L1 sink; Heterogeneous expression in solid tumors
targets.notes: Pediatric solid-tumor and gynecologic-cancer mixed-evidence target.

targets.localization_notes: Seven-transmembrane R-spondin co-receptor (UniProt O75473); marks adult intestinal stem cells and CRC stem-like cells.
targets.cancer_relevance: Stem-cell marker over-expressed on a fraction of colorectal cancer (Wnt-high tumors), gastric, ovarian, and hepatocellular carcinomas. ADC and biparatopic concepts explored preclinically.
targets.liabilities: Adult intestinal stem-cell expression -> on-target GI toxicity risk; Antigen heterogeneity; Conformation-dependent epitopes
targets.notes: Cancer-stem-cell marker with CRC organoid evidence.

targets.protein_name: Leukocyte immunoglobulin-like receptor subfamily B member 4
targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane inhibitory Ig-like receptor (UniProt Q8NHJ6).
targets.cancer_relevance: Surface marker of monocytic acute myeloid leukemia (M4/M5 AML) and chronic myelomonocytic leukemia with restricted normal expression on monocytes/tolerogenic DCs. IO-202 (anti-LILRB4) in phase-1 trials.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: LILRB4 IHC/flow restricted to monocytic AML/CMML vs normal-tissue baseline; phase-1 IO-202 paper (PMID 40919482).
targets.liabilities: Normal monocyte/dendritic-cell expression; AML lineage restriction -> off-target in non-monocytic subtypes; Antigen modulation
targets.notes: Monocytic-AML clinical-stage target.

targets.localization_notes: GPI-anchored cell-surface protein of the Ly6 family (UniProt Q16553).
targets.cancer_relevance: Up-regulated in triple-negative breast cancer and identified as a theranostic target; drives lung metastasis via PD-L1-coupled transcription. ADC DLYE5953A explored clinically.
targets.liabilities: Some normal lymphocyte and intestinal expression; Limited clinical program currently; Macrophage expression complicates tumor-cell vs immune-cell targeting
targets.notes: Strong preclinical TNBC theranostic signal.

targets.localization_notes: GPI-anchored surface protein of the Ly6 family (UniProt O95274).
targets.cancer_relevance: Over-expressed in NSCLC, ESCC, and other carcinomas; pan-cancer analysis identifies LYPD3 as prognostic and as a candidate ADC target (lupartumab amadotin was a clinical-stage ADC).
targets.liabilities: Limited current clinical program after lupartumab discontinuation; Some normal-skin and esophageal expression
targets.notes: Re-emerging surfaceome target with new bioinformatic + cell-line backing.

targets.localization_notes: Intracellular cancer/testis antigen presented on HLA class I (UniProt P43355).
targets.cancer_relevance: Cancer/testis antigen up-regulated across melanoma, NSCLC, ESCC, ovarian, and hematologic malignancies; TCR-T (TAEST16001) and TCR-mimic antibodies in preclinical/early-clinical development.
targets.liabilities: HLA restriction; Antigen heterogeneity; Need for high-affinity TCR engineering
targets.default_assay: Antigen expression by IHC or RT-PCR, plus HLA class I genotyping
targets.notes: Cancer/testis antigen with TCR-T and T-cell engager programs.

targets.localization_notes: Intracellular cancer/testis antigen presented on HLA class I (UniProt P43358; afami-cel TCR-T literature PMID 36624315).
targets.cancer_relevance: Cancer/testis antigen expressed in ~70-80% of synovial sarcoma, ~25% of myxoid/round-cell liposarcoma, and subsets of NSCLC, head-and-neck, esophageal, gastric, melanoma, and ovarian cancers. Afamitresgene autoleucel (afami-cel) is the first FDA-approved TCR-T therapy (synovial sarcoma).
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: Phase 1 trial PMID 36624315 (Hong 2023) demonstrated tumor-specific MAGE-A4 expression in HLA-A*02+ solid cancers; SPEARHEAD-1 phase 2 (PMID 38554725) confirmed clinical benefit; FDA approval summary PMID 40423661 and 'first approval' review PMID 39404764 cover prevalence/normal-tissue restriction.
targets.liabilities: Requires HLA-A*02:01 restriction; Antigen heterogeneity; Cytokine release with TCR-T
targets.default_assay: Antigen expression by IHC or RT-PCR, plus HLA class I genotyping
targets.notes: Intracellular HLA-presented; TCR-T or TCR-mimic mAbs only.

targets.localization_notes: Intracellular cancer/testis antigen accessed via HLA class I (UniProt Q9UBF1).
targets.cancer_relevance: Cancer/testis antigen up-regulated in melanoma, HCC, sarcoma, and other malignancies through DNA-hypomethylation; TCR-T and peptide-vaccine concepts.
targets.liabilities: HLA restriction; Heterogeneous expression; Hypomethylation-dependent silencing on relapse
targets.default_assay: Antigen expression by IHC or RT-PCR, plus HLA class I genotyping
targets.notes: Cancer/testis HLA-presented target -- TCR-T / TCR-mimic only.

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane TAM-family RTK (UniProt Q12866).
targets.cancer_relevance: Aberrantly expressed on acute leukemia, glioblastoma, melanoma, and NSCLC tumor cells, and on tumor-promoting macrophages; preclinical CAR-T and bispecifics targeting MERTK described.
targets.liabilities: Retinal photoreceptor MERTK function (retinitis-pigmentosa biology) -> on-target ocular risk; Macrophage/efferocytosis expression; Limited clinical program
targets.notes: TAM-family RTK with tumor + macrophage component.

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane RTK (UniProt P08581); membranous tumor expression.
targets.cancer_relevance: Amplification (~1-5% NSCLC), exon-14-skipping mutations (~3% NSCLC adeno), and protein over-expression define MET-addicted tumor subsets; also relevant in gastric, hepatocellular, and papillary renal cell carcinoma. Both small-molecule and antibody-based (telisotuzumab vedotin) ADC strategies are under active clinical development.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: Reviews PMID 36441095 and 40681868 summarize MET amplification/overexpression vs. normal-tissue baselines and clinical outcomes; PMID 37451931 (systematic review) characterizes MET exon-14 skipping prevalence and tumor specificity.
targets.liabilities: Hepatic and GI on-target effects from normal hepatocyte MET; Peripheral edema with small-molecule MET inhibitors; Antigen heterogeneity between primary and metastatic sites

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane metalloproteinase (UniProt P50281); surface-bound on tumor and stromal cells.
targets.cancer_relevance: Surface-bound metalloprotease over-expressed on invasive carcinomas (breast, pancreatic, head-and-neck), driving ECM degradation and metastasis. Active-site mAbs (DX-2400) and ADC concepts explored preclinically.
targets.liabilities: Wound-healing / vascular MMP14 expression; Catalytic homology with other MT-MMPs requires selectivity engineering; Limited clinical program
targets.notes: Surface-bound protease, attractive for catalytic-trap and ADC strategies.

targets.localization_notes: GPI-anchored surface protein with a cleaved soluble form (megakaryocyte potentiating factor / SMRP) detectable in serum (UniProt Q13421).
targets.cancer_relevance: Strongly over-expressed in mesothelioma (>85% of epithelioid), pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (~80-90%), ovarian (~70%), and subsets of cholangiocarcinoma, NSCLC, and triple-negative breast cancer, vs. very limited normal mesothelial expression. Active modalities: immunotoxins (LMB-100), CAR-T, bispecifics, ADCs.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: Review PMID 32605175 (NIH/NCI Pastan group) collates IHC of mesothelin across tumors vs normal mesothelium; PMID 40696802 describes a trivalent anti-MSLN x CD3 bispecific exploiting this differential.
targets.liabilities: Soluble shed mesothelin acts as a sink that blunts mAb/CAR potency; Capillary-leak and pleuritis with high-affinity binders; Pleural / pericardial normal expression poses on-target risk
targets.default_assay: Tumor-cell protein expression by IHC; serum/plasma assay where a validated one exists
targets.notes: Antigen shedding is the single biggest design constraint for binder engineering.

targets.protein_name: Mucin-1 (MUC1-C / MUC1-CT cleavage product accessible on tumor surface)
targets.localization_notes: Heavily glycosylated single-pass type I transmembrane mucin (UniProt P15941); tumor-specific aberrant glycoforms (Tn, sialyl-Tn, MUC1-C) expose neoepitopes.
targets.cancer_relevance: Over-expressed and aberrantly glycosylated in >90% of breast, ovarian, pancreatic, NSCLC, and CRC adenocarcinomas with neoepitopes not present on normal mucin. Active modalities: CAR-T (anti-Tn-MUC1 / 5E5), bispecifics, peptide vaccines (TG4010), MUC1-C small molecules.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: Reviews PMIDs 34207342, 24667139, 20635898, and 10571020 catalog MUC1 expression and tumor-specific aberrant glycoforms vs. normal apical mucin.
targets.liabilities: Soluble shed MUC1 sink; Wild-type MUC1 on normal epithelia means antibody specificity for tumor glycoforms is critical; Heterogeneous glycosylation
targets.default_assay: Tumor-cell protein expression by IHC; serum/plasma assay where a validated one exists
targets.notes: The therapeutic opportunity is in tumor-specific glycoforms or the MUC1-C cytoplasmic tail accessible after cleavage, not pan-MUC1.

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane Ig-like adhesion molecule (UniProt Q96NY8); membrane staining in urothelial tumor cells.
targets.cancer_relevance: Highly and lineage-restricted expression in urothelial carcinoma (>83% strongly positive in cohort series), with additional expression in subsets of breast, NSCLC, pancreatic, and head-and-neck cancers. Validated ADC target (enfortumab vedotin) approved for advanced urothelial carcinoma.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: Review PMID 40209851 summarizes Nectin-4 expression across tumor types and contrasts with restricted normal-tissue baseline; PMID 38609704 details clinical pharmacology of enfortumab vedotin built on this tumor-skewed expression; PMID 40129250 reports EV+pembrolizumab redefining 1L urothelial care.
targets.liabilities: Skin (keratinocyte) Nectin-4 drives cutaneous AEs including TEN; Peripheral neuropathy / ocular AEs with MMAE payload; Down-regulation under EV pressure (acquired resistance)
targets.notes: Indication-specific (urothelial) but broadly relevant for pan-cancer ADC strategy benchmarking.

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass sialomucin on the apical / non-junctional surface of epithelia (UniProt O00592).
targets.cancer_relevance: Cell-surface sialomucin marking aggressive renal, ovarian, pancreatic, and breast carcinomas; PODXL-high tumors are associated with poor prognosis. PR1A3 / 3D3 / PODOCAN antibodies described preclinically.
targets.liabilities: Normal podocyte and endothelial expression; Glycosylation-dependent epitope choice; No approved binder
targets.notes: Pan-carcinoma surfaceome candidate.

targets.protein_name: Melanoma antigen preferentially expressed in tumors
targets.localization_notes: Intracellular protein; therapeutic accessibility via HLA-A*02:01-restricted peptides (PRAME-004 epitope SLLQHLIGL) (UniProt P78395; PMIDs 31311081, 39326690).
targets.cancer_relevance: Over-expressed in cutaneous melanoma (~90%), uveal melanoma (~50%), and subsets of NSCLC, breast, ovarian, sarcoma, with germline-restricted normal expression. Brenetafusp (PRAME ImmTAC bispecific TCR) is in active trials; multiple TCR-T programs.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: Reviews PMIDs 38338862, 39326690, 39451258, and 31311081 collate PRAME IHC in melanoma vs. normal tissues, supporting diagnostic and therapeutic use.
targets.liabilities: HLA restriction limits eligible patients; Cytokine release with bispecific TCR; Antigen heterogeneity within tumors
targets.default_assay: Antigen expression by IHC or RT-PCR, plus HLA class I genotyping
targets.notes: Intracellular HLA-presented; TCR-T / ImmTAC modalities.

targets.localization_notes: GPI-anchored surface protein (UniProt O43653) on prostate, pancreatic, gastric and bladder epithelium.
targets.cancer_relevance: Up-regulated in prostate cancer (>80% of high-grade), pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, gastric and bladder cancers. Multiple CAR-T (CARMA, allogeneic gd-T BNT211 family) and bispecifics in preclinical / phase-1.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: PSCA IHC in prostate, pancreatic and gastric cancers vs limited normal-tissue baseline (reviews referenced in PMID 41951504).
targets.liabilities: Normal prostate / bladder / pancreas expression; Heterogeneous expression in PDAC; Antigen-loss escape with CAR-T
targets.notes: Prostate/PDAC mixed-evidence target.

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane pseudokinase (UniProt Q13308); planar-cell-polarity component.
targets.cancer_relevance: Up-regulated in TNBC, NSCLC, ovarian, and esophageal carcinomas. Cofetuzumab pelidotin (PF-06647020) and newer PTK7 ADCs are clinical / preclinical-stage.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: PTK7 IHC in TNBC, NSCLC vs normal epithelium documented in PF-06647020 development (cached PTK7_solid_rel summaries).
targets.liabilities: Normal-tissue planar-cell-polarity expression; Heterogeneous tumor expression; ADC payload toxicities
targets.notes: TNBC/NSCLC mixed-evidence ADC target.

targets.protein_name: Inactive tyrosine-protein kinase transmembrane receptor ROR1
targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane Wnt5a co-receptor (UniProt Q01973).
targets.cancer_relevance: Onco-fetal surface receptor re-expressed in CLL, MCL, TNBC, ovarian, NSCLC, and pancreatic carcinomas with absent adult normal expression. Zilovertamab vedotin ADC (VLS-101) in clinical trials.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: ROR1 IHC over-expression in MCL, TNBC, and lung adenocarcinoma vs absent in normal adult tissues (cached ROR1_solid_hema summaries).
targets.liabilities: Embryonic / developmental expression; Heterogeneity across hematologic and solid subsets; ADC ocular AEs
targets.notes: Onco-fetal surface receptor with broad mixed-evidence pan-cancer profile.

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane neuronal cell-surface protein (UniProt Q53EL9).
targets.cancer_relevance: Neuroendocrine-lineage surface antigen enriched in small-cell lung cancer; ABBV-011 / ABBV-706 anti-SEZ6 ADC in active development.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: SEZ6 IHC across SCLC vs normal lung and adult CNS (referenced in PMIDs 41985715, 41761743).
targets.liabilities: CNS expression in normal neurons (BBB-protected but a consideration); Neuroendocrine plasticity may reduce SEZ6 in some SCLC subtypes; Calicheamicin / topo payload toxicities
targets.notes: Complementary to DLL3 in SCLC.

targets.localization_notes: Multi-pass plasma-membrane phosphate transporter (UniProt O95436); apical in normal alveolar type II cells.
targets.cancer_relevance: Highly expressed in high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma, lung adenocarcinoma, and thyroid cancer with apically restricted normal-tissue expression. Lifastuzumab vedotin (DNIB0600A) and upifitamab rilsodotin (XMT-1536) are ADCs targeting NaPi2b.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: NaPi2b expression characterized in ovarian and lung adenocarcinoma vs normal apical pneumocytes in upifitamab and lifastuzumab clinical-stage development (referenced in review PMID 40743868).
targets.liabilities: Pulmonary alveolar microlithiasis biology -- on-target lung toxicity risk; ADC ocular AEs (XMT-1536); Heterogeneous expression in HGSOC
targets.notes: ADC programs in clinical trials; broad expression on serous ovarian and lung adeno.

targets.localization_notes: Multi-pass plasma-membrane choline-like transporter (UniProt Q53GD3); polarized in epithelia.
targets.cancer_relevance: Up-regulated in pancreatic adenocarcinoma where it remodels extracellular matrix and drives proliferation, migration, and invasion via PI3K/AKT; also a prognostic biomarker in colorectal cancer.
targets.liabilities: Limited normal-tissue profiling; No clinical-stage binder yet; Cleavage products may complicate ADC payload internalization
targets.notes: Pancreatic / GI surface target with fresh preclinical signal.

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane neural-development protein (UniProt Q9H5Y7).
targets.cancer_relevance: Expressed on urothelial carcinoma and a fraction of NSCLC and glioma. Sirtratumab vedotin (ASG-15ME) ADC explored in urothelial cancer.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: SLITRK6 IHC in urothelial vs limited normal-tissue baseline (cached SLITRK6_urothelial_rel; PMID 30844889).
targets.liabilities: Normal inner-ear / CNS expression; Heterogeneous expression in urothelial; ADC ocular AEs
targets.notes: Urothelial mixed-evidence ADC target complementary to Nectin-4.

targets.localization_notes: Seven-transmembrane GPCR on neuroendocrine cells (UniProt P30874).
targets.cancer_relevance: Highly expressed on well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumors (carcinoid, pancreatic NETs), pituitary tumors, meningiomas, and a subset of SCLC/MTC. Validated radioligand-therapy target (177Lu-DOTATATE; Lutathera, NETTER-1/2) and PET imaging (68Ga-DOTATATE).
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: SSTR2 expression on NETs by PET imaging vs limited normal-tissue baseline; reviews and trials referenced in PMIDs 42035386, 41954240.
targets.liabilities: Renal accumulation with peptide radioligand therapy; Lymphopenia / hematologic toxicity; SSTR loss in dedifferentiated NETs
targets.notes: Theranostic-target paradigm with Lutathera approval.

targets.localization_notes: Intracellular cancer/testis antigen accessed via HLA class I (UniProt Q16385).
targets.cancer_relevance: Cancer/testis antigen up-regulated in synovial sarcoma (chimeric SS18-SSX), melanoma, prostate, and HCC. Multiple HLA-A*02-restricted peptides characterized; TCR-T candidates preclinical.
targets.liabilities: HLA restriction limits patient eligibility; Antigen heterogeneity; Cross-reactivity to SSX1/SSX4 must be controlled
targets.default_assay: Antigen expression by IHC or RT-PCR, plus HLA class I genotyping
targets.notes: Cancer/testis antigen with TCR-T potential, especially in synovial sarcoma.

targets.localization_notes: Six-transmembrane epithelial antigen of the prostate (UniProt Q9UHE8); plasma-membrane localization confirmed by HPA and STEAP review (PMID 36011027).
targets.cancer_relevance: Highly expressed in prostate cancer (including mCRPC), with additional expression in Ewing sarcoma, bladder, and a subset of breast cancers. Lead programs: vandortuzumab vedotin (early), xaluritamig (STEAP1 x CD3 bispecific), CAR-T.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: Reviews PMIDs 40169837, 41131283, 36011027, and 40299363 collate IHC expression in prostate cancer vs. normal prostate / normal tissues, motivating its use as an alternative or complementary target to PSMA.
targets.liabilities: Some normal prostate, urothelial, and pancreatic expression; Complex six-transmembrane topology limits accessible epitopes; Heterogeneous expression in mCRPC

targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane glycoprotein on epithelia (UniProt P09758).
targets.cancer_relevance: Broadly overexpressed across epithelial tumors -- TNBC, HR+/HER2- breast, NSCLC (adeno and squamous), urothelial, gastric, ovarian, head-and-neck -- relative to most normal epithelia. Validated ADC target (sacituzumab govitecan, datopotamab deruxtecan).
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: Reviews PMIDs 38948057 and 40517574 collate IHC/RNA evidence of TROP2 over-expression in TNBC and NSCLC vs. low/restricted normal-tissue expression; clinical activity of sacituzumab govitecan (PMID 39135109) and dato-DXd (PMID 38502995) is contingent on this tumor-skewed expression.
targets.liabilities: Expression on normal epithelium (skin, GI) drives mucositis/skin AEs; Variable IHC dynamic range complicates patient selection; Interstitial lung disease with deruxtecan payloads
targets.notes: Sacituzumab govitecan is the lead approved binder; downstream agents should look at second-gen ADCs and bispecifics.

targets.protein_name: Tumor necrosis factor receptor superfamily member 10B (DR5)
targets.localization_notes: Single-pass type I transmembrane death receptor (UniProt O14763).
targets.cancer_relevance: Death receptor surface-up-regulated on multiple carcinomas; second-generation hexavalent agonists (IGM-8444, eftozanermin alfa, BI 905711) re-engaged the target clinically after first-generation TRAIL biologics failed.
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: DR5 up-regulation in tumor vs normal documented in carcinoma cell-line panels and TCGA review (PMID 42103248).
targets.liabilities: Hepatocellular DR5 expression -> on-target hepatotoxicity for high-avidity agonists; Death-receptor resistance mechanisms (FLIP, cIAP); Need for multivalent crosslinking
targets.notes: Re-emerging target with multivalent agonist designs.

targets.localization_notes: Type III transmembrane TNF-receptor-family protein; cleaved by gamma-secretase to a soluble shed form (UniProt Q02223).
targets.cancer_relevance: Lineage-restricted to plasma cells and uniformly expressed across multiple myeloma; included in this pan-cancer list as the canonical hematologic surface target informing solid-tumor binder design. Four FDA-approved binders span CAR-T (ide-cel, cilta-cel), bispecifics (teclistamab, elranatamab), and an ADC (belantamab mafodotin).
targets.tumor_vs_normal_evidence: Reviews PMIDs 32943087 and 37055515 describe BCMA expression on myeloma plasma cells vs. negligible expression elsewhere; meta-analysis PMID 33272302 documents efficacy of BCMA CAR-T contingent on this lineage restriction.
targets.liabilities: Soluble shed BCMA sink; Antigen loss / down-regulation on relapse; Normal plasma-cell depletion (humoral immunity)
targets.default_assay: Tumor-cell protein expression by IHC; serum/plasma assay where a validated one exists
targets.notes: Hematologic exemplar -- next stage may use only as binder-design reference unless solid-tumor BCMA+ subsets surface.

targets.localization_notes: Four-transmembrane tetraspanin (UniProt P19075); enriched on tumor-derived exosomes.
targets.cancer_relevance: Up-regulated in colorectal, pancreatic, gastric, and hepatocellular carcinomas; drives metastasis and is enriched on tumor-derived exosomes. Anti-TSPAN8 mAbs explored preclinically.
targets.liabilities: Limited normal-tissue profiling; Tetraspanin biology requires careful epitope choice; Exosomal antigen sink potential
targets.notes: Tetraspanin with GI / pancreatic preclinical signal.
